subject: FinIntegrate: Steering committee scheduling & exec sponsor prep
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Kim <alyssa.kim@finintegrate.com>, Tom Rivers <trivers@fintegrate.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: FinIntegrate discovery follow-up: steering committee & next steps

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today - appreciate the candor on current pain (latency spikes during peak batch jobs, auditability requirements) and the broad use cases you outlined (customer-facing copilots + internal knowledge retrieval). Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can align on a steering committee with the right exec sponsorship and procurement/security attendees.

Recap (high level)
- Priority outcomes: 1) predictable latency under load, 2) clear audit logs & KMS integration, 3) predictable unit economics.
- Primary technical owners: Tom Rivers (CPO), Maya Shah (Dir, InfoSec), Jordan Lee (Procurement).
- Typical timeline you mentioned: internal vendor short-list next 4-6 weeks; steering committee to recommend solution to exec team.

Proposed next steps
1) Steering committee meeting (60 minutes) to include: Tom (exec sponsor), procurement, InfoSec, IT (network), and 1-2 solution owners. Goal: align on decision criteria, integration constraints, and procurement path.
2) Redwood will provide: a 10-12 slide steering deck, a mutual action plan (timeline + owners), and a short security artifact packet (SOC2, KMS notes).
3) Pricing: we can share a high-level range for budgeting in advance of the committee.

Scheduling ask: Do you have availability for a 60-minute steering committee the week of Dec 1-5? Our initial suggested slots (all ET):
- Tue Dec 1, 11:00-12:00 ET
- Wed Dec 2, 10:00-11:00 ET
- Thu Dec 3, 14:00-15:00 ET

If those don't work, share the best day/time and who from your side must attend (economic buyer / legal / procurement / security). I'm CC'ing Marissa (CSM) and Neha (security enablement) to prep artifacts and own follow-ups.

Attachments: redwood-steering-deck-v1.pdf (PDF), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (Excel)

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
From: Alyssa Kim <alyssa.kim@finintegrate.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rivers <trivers@fintegrate.com>, Jordan Lee <procurement@finintegrate.com>, Maya Shah <mshah@fintegrate.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0500
Subject: Re: FinIntegrate discovery follow-up: steering committee & next steps

Hey Sean - thanks for the clear recap and helpful artifacts. This aligns with our internal read. A few quick notes: 
- Exec sponsor: Tom Rivers will be the owner for the steering committee. He wants the meeting to be one hour and see a short executive summary up front.
- Procurement: copying Jordan (procurement) who will handle the vendor evaluation loop.
- InfoSec: Maya (copied) will join for the security discussion.

Availability: Dec 1 or Dec 2 works best for Tom. He prefers earlier in the day on Dec 1. Jordan asked if you can share a high-level pricing range up front so procurement can prep (ballpark is fine). Also please include any compliance artifacts (SOC2 summary, encryption/KMS notes).

Can you do Tue Dec 1 at 11:00 ET? If that works we'll get internal invites out (Tom, Maya, Jordan + 2 solution owners).

Thanks - Alyssa
Alyssa Kim
Head of Product Partnerships | FinIntegrate
alyssa.kim@finintegrate.com
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Kim <alyssa.kim@fintegrate.com>, Tom Rivers <trivers@fintegrate.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, Jordan Lee <procurement@fintegrate.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinIntegrate discovery follow-up: steering committee & next steps

Perfect - Tue Dec 1, 11:00-12:00 ET is penciled on our side. I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm the attendee list.

Proposed attendees (Redwood): Sean Gallagher (AE), Marissa Cole (CSM, will lead steering deck & SSO/KMS notes), Neha Kapoor (Security Enablement, SOC2 + architecture Q&A).
Proposed agenda (60m)
- 00:00-00:05 - Introductions & objectives (Tom)
- 00:05-00:15 - Exec summary: opportunity, fit, and recommended engagement model (Sean)
- 00:15-00:30 - Technical approach & integration touchpoints (Marissa + Neha)
- 00:30-00:45 - Procurement & commercial model (high-level pricing band) (Sean)
- 00:45-00:55 - Risk & compliance Q&A (Neha)
- 00:55-01:00 - Next steps / mutual action items (all)

High-level pricing range for budgeting: for a deployment that matches the volume profile you shared (peaks with burst capacity, mixed small/long sequences), typical annual committed ranges we've seen for orgs your size fall between $250k-750k ARR depending on commitment level and dedications. We can tighten that range after we align on throughput/latency SLOs and retention requirements.

Marissa - can you confirm you'll own the deck and pull the short compliance packet (SOC2 summary, KMS notes, example audit logs)? Neha - loop in any network/topology constraints we should call out.

Attachments for the meeting: redwood-steering-deck-v1.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Thanks - I'll follow up with a calendar invite once Alyssa confirms the final attendee list.

- Sean
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:34:00 -0800

On it - I'll take the lead on the steering deck and assemble a 1-page compliance packet tailored to the items Alyssa called out. Plan:
- 10-slide steering deck (exec summary + decision criteria + integration ask)
- 1-page compliance summary (SOC2 snapshot, KMS/HSM options, audit log retention and access controls)
- A short appendix with example SSO/SAML diagrams and a sample data flow for bookkeeping.

I'll pull the SOC2 artifact references and a brief KMS integration note (we support customer-managed keys via major cloud KMS providers; will list exact options). Neha - if you can provide the 2-3 network/topology caveats we should flag that would be great (eg. IP allowlists, egress patterns).

I'll aim to send the deck and compliance packet by Mon Nov 29 EOD so the FinIntegrate team has time to review before the Dec 1 meeting.

Thanks,
